identificationModule.officialTitle: Single Center, Prospective, Randomized, Partly-Double Blinded, Controlled Trial to Assess the Safety and Feasibility of Intracoronary Cell Infusion Mobilized With G-CSF and Darbepoetin and Their Effects on Improvement of Cardiac Function in Patients With Myocardial Infarction: Myocardial Regeneration and Angiogenesis in Myocardial Infarction With G-CSF and Erythropoietin Mobilization and Intra-Coronary Cell Infusion -5-Combination Cytokine Therapy Trial

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Combination use of darbepoetin and G-CSF will improve left ventricular systolic function in patients with acute myocardial infarction who receive intracoronary infusion of mobilized peripheral blood stem cell in comparison with patient who treated with conventional measures and who received intracoronary infusion of mobilized peripheral blood stem cell by G-CSF alone.

interventions.name: G-CSF with/without darbepoetin, peripheral blood stem cell infusion

primaryOutcomes.measure: change of left ventricular ejection fraction measured by cardiac MRI

secondaryOutcomes.measure: wall motion score index exercise capacity BNP

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ST elevation acute myocardial infarction
* \< 80years
* successful revascularization of culprit vessel

Exclusion Criteria:

* uncontrolled congestive heart failure
* uncontrolled myocardial ischemia
* uncontrolled ventricular arrhythmia
* malignancy
* serious hematologic disease
* chronic renal failure
